retained_figure.observation: Both synthetic and clinical volume curves overlap the supplied-mask curve; both radial-strain bars exceed the dashed 5 pp target. Corresponding numerical endpoints were regraded.
retained_figure.limit: Historical figure is a selected aggregate, not the canonical story or independent strain visualization.

method_review.evidence: Original submitted solve.py, method.md, assessment.json and prediction.npz match original receipt hashes. Original session traces match their receipt hashes; historical recorded runtime/search audit is retained, not independently reclassified here.
method_review.masks: Signed-distance TV-L1 registration; five tetrahedra per occupied voxel; Gaussian regularization; positive-J filtering; final centroid and total-volume correction (solve.py lines 202-224).
method_review.masks_images: Six tetrahedra per voxel; residual texture flow capped at 2 mm and tangent-projected (lines 169-214), used only when images exist and mask_semantics is myocardial_wall (line 282). Final centroid/volume correction at lines 350-356.
method_review.clinical: Both unchanged programs use masks for the cavity transfer; image-program texture branch is disabled for cavity semantics. Its synthetic advantage cannot be inferred from the clinical EF result.
method_review.confounders: Two independently authored programs and tetrahedralizations, one shared synthetic case, no controlled image ablation. Descriptive error differences are not causal estimates.

limits: Source material truth is synthetic and source-derived, not measured patient strain.
All 47186 source-cell centroids enter coverage; directional metrics require positive AHA labels and complete axes. Both agent maps cover 45970 probes and 98.0557 percent reference volume.
Construction reward excludes the separate material gates and post-hoc boundary-edge/Jacobian-tail diagnostics. Original rewards and raw attempts remain unchanged.
Positive local Jacobians do not establish global injectivity, self-intersection freedom or force equilibrium.
Clinical all-phase cavity masks already encode the reference volume curve. No material validation or independent EF recovery is implied.
The clinical assessments retain incorrect absence-of-timestamp boilerplate; source metadata contain real timestamps. No strain-rate claim is requested or added.
Six full saved scores were regraded. Empty-answer/Docker controls and analytic ambiguity controls are retained historical evidence, not newly executed trials.
Current review reuses the pinned STRAUS and clinical source audits; it does not claim a new exhaustive licensing investigation.
Delivery scope, canonical story, portable asset integration, exports and complete visual acceptance remain unresolved.
